comment: Startup JSON budget (P4-05): decoded bytes of the committed static JSON/GeoJSON files Morro Bay's map fetches with no interaction until the network is quiet, with live feeds stubbed (scripts/measure_startup.mjs --stub). Live feeds (/api/*, /feeds/*, the ArcGIS MPA query) move with upstream data and are reported, not budgeted. max_bytes is the measured value + 10%. The guide's target (all startup JSON) is 400 KB; lower this as later slices cut more.
